subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

A period of free outdoor play can provide a very necessary __respite__ from the hustle and bustle of the day.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Break.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"respite"** means a short period of rest or relief from something difficult or unpleasant. (विश्राम)

 

 
• **Example: **After working for several hours without a break, they finally had a short respite to relax.

 

 

 
• **"Break" **refers to a pause in work or during an activity for rest or refreshment. (विराम)

 

 
• **Example: **They took a short break to enjoy some coffee and snacks.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Break.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Progression **(उन्नति): The process of developing or moving gradually towards a more advanced state.

 

 
• **Example:** His progression in the company was rapid due to his hard work and dedication.

 

 

 
• **Commencement **(आरंभ ): The beginning or start of something.

 

 
• **Example: **The commencement of the new project was marked by a grand ceremony.

 

 

 
• **Continuation** (जारी रहना): The action of carrying something on over a period of time.

 

 
• **Example:** The continuation of the meeting was scheduled for the next day.

The correct answer is: Option 2
